sections.overview: The Rainbow Seaperch is an eastern Pacific surfperch in Embiotocidae. It usually lives around rocky shores and kelp edges, unlike Hyperprosopon argenteum.
sections.identification: It reaches about 30 cm. Its silvery body shows blue iridescence around the head.
sections.habitat: It ranges from northern California to northern Baja, at depths of 1–50 m.
sections.diet: Prey include crustaceans, snails and polychaete worms.
sections.behavior: Adults gather in autumn, usually near rocky shores and kelp beds.
sections.reproduction: Females carry developing young internally; the species is viviparous.
sections.ecology: Its rocky habitat contrasts with the sandy surf used by H. argenteum.
sections.conservation: FishBase lists the species as not globally evaluated by IUCN.
